offline_candidate_preparation.condition: commit the prepared candidate and record its full SHA and changed-file allowlist before the first external action

local_services: run-owned temporary ComfyUI using the existing target Python and main.py read-only

required_preconditions: the prepared external-execution candidate is a committed descendant of authorized_start_candidate_sha and changes only the frozen WP-S1-03 allowlist
the executed custom-node bundle, workflow/API files and harness hashes equal the prepared candidate blobs
the authorized image SHA-256 matches before copying it into the run-owned input root
Windows-native and WSL GPU samples agree within 128 MiB and used memory is <=4096 MiB before service start
no target ComfyUI/Ollama process and no listener on 8191/11434 before service start
OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD is observed true and the owned Ollama PID has no non-loopback connection for at least 10 seconds and at least 5 samples
all workflow class_type values are present in the live target registry before the effective image attempt
required_checks: drive the real image through public Comfy /prompt and /history using LVWControlledImageInput and the bound visual owner
prove raw_response, suggestion, draft and draft_epoch isolation with the live registered nodes
exercise the manual CPU/export public route with Ollama unavailable without counting it as an image/model attempt
retain stable failure codes for corrupt/over-limit/stale/timeout/refusal/OOM fixtures without automatic retry or draft overwrite
bind all evidence to the prepared candidate, target fingerprints, run ID and fixed S1 denominator while leaving product cases NOT_RUN until independent review
mandatory_stops: prepared candidate, bundle, workflow, harness, model or sample mismatch
changed file falls outside the frozen WP-S1-03 allowlist
pre-service identity, GPU, process or port gate failure
no-cloud or non-loopback network gate failure
GPU memory reaches or exceeds 23552 MiB
public /prompt, /history, registry, semantic Oracle or state-isolation failure
model call, effective image attempt or public API submission budget would be exceeded
per-call unload, final cleanup, target integrity or privacy minimization gap
forbidden: downloads, upgrades or permanent target configuration writes
product contract, fixed denominator, owner, Oracle, timeout or threshold changes
use of any media other than the single hash-bound image
reuse or extension of the expired S0 authorization
evidence_minimization: persist aliases, hashes, aggregate counts, authorized listener owner IDs and redacted diagnostics only; never persist private absolute sample paths, unrelated process tables, unrelated command lines or original media bytes
cleanup: unload every started model call, require terminal /api/ps empty, stop run-owned PIDs, prove ports empty, remove the run-owned base/input/output/temp bundle, and prove C:/ComfyUI target fingerprints unchanged
expires_when: one terminal WP-S1-03 receipt is generated, the single effective image attempt is consumed, or any mandatory stop occurs
